title: Uncaught TypeError when submitting feedback form without email
description: When a guest user submits a bug report without filling in the optional reporter email, the client throws a TypeError reading property 'trim' of undefined and the form gets stuck in loading state.
stepsToReproduce:
1. Open the public bug submission form at /submit/form-123
2. Fill in bug title and description
3. Leave the reporter email empty
4. Click 'Submit Report'
5. Notice the submit button shows spinner indefinitely and console displays error
environment: OS: macOS Sonoma 14.5, Browser: Chrome 126.0.6478.127, Viewport: 1920x1080
logs:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')
    at validateForm (src/components/FormSubmit.tsx:42:25)
    at handleSubmit (src/components/FormSubmit.tsx:78:12)
    at HTMLButtonElement.dispatch (node_modules/react-dom/cjs/react-dom.production.min.js:14:105)

investigationNotes.author: triage-bot
investigationNotes.hypothesis: Email field might be initialized as undefined instead of empty string in form state.
investigationNotes.details: Validator expects a string and invokes .trim() directly without checking for null/undefined.
investigationNotes.suggestedFix: Use optional chaining (email?.trim()) or default to empty string.

title: Auth token expiration causes 500 error instead of 401 redirect
description: When the JWT expires during an active session, API requests to /api/bugs return 500 Internal Server Error due to unhandled TokenExpiredError instead of 401 Unauthorized.
stepsToReproduce:
1. Log in to admin dashboard
2. Wait for JWT token to expire or alter token expiration in local storage
3. Refresh bug list or navigate to /admin/bugs
4. Dashboard displays generic server error modal instead of redirecting to /auth
logs:
TokenExpiredError: jwt expired
    at /server/middleware/auth.js:28:19
    at JsonWebTokenError.verify (/server/node_modules/jsonwebtoken/index.js:120:7)

title: Analytics aggregation slow query when submissions exceed 10,000
description: GET /api/insights takes over 4.5 seconds to return because status/severity counts perform a full table scan without compound index on (userId, createdAt).
stepsToReproduce:
1. Populate test database with 15k submissions
2. Open /admin/analytics
3. Measure network response time for GET /api/insights
